tasks.title: Configure Sheets-Only Build
tasks.description: Set up the build configuration to serve only the Sheets example at /sheets.
tasks.details: Modify examples/esbuild.config.ts to set entryPoints to ./src/sheets/main.ts and ./src/sheets/worker.ts. Ensure the build serves at http://localhost:3000/sheets.
tasks.testStrategy: Run pnpm --filter univer-examples dev:demo and verify that http://localhost:3000/sheets loads correctly with the Sheets UI.

tasks.title: Remove Unnecessary Demos
tasks.description: Delete all demo sources and public files except for Sheets.
tasks.details: Delete examples/src/* except examples/src/sheets/** and any shared files it imports. Delete examples/public/* except examples/public/sheets/** and shared assets like favicon.svg.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure no 404 errors occur when accessing /sheets and that no other demos are accessible.

tasks.title: Trim Plugins for Sheets
tasks.description: Reduce the plugin set to only those necessary for Sheets functionality.
tasks.details: In examples/src/sheets/main.ts, remove unnecessary plugins like UniverDocsPlugin and UniverDocsUIPlugin. Keep only essential plugins for core Sheets functionality.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the Sheets UI functions correctly with the reduced plugin set, including editing, formatting, and filtering.

tasks.title: Prune Package Dependencies
tasks.description: Remove unused package dependencies from examples/package.json.
tasks.details: Remove dependencies related to docs, slides, and other unused features. Keep only those required for Sheets functionality and optional CSV/XLSX support.
tasks.testStrategy: Run pnpm install and ensure the build process completes without errors. Verify Sheets functionality remains intact.

tasks.title: Remove Unused Workspace Packages
tasks.description: Delete unused workspace packages to streamline the project.
tasks.details: Iteratively delete unused packages in packages/** and packages-experimental/**. Rebuild and verify functionality after each deletion.
tasks.testStrategy: After each package removal, rebuild the project and verify that /sheets loads and functions correctly.

tasks.title: Clean Up Build Configuration
tasks.description: Remove unnecessary build configurations and scripts.
tasks.details: If Uniscript is removed, drop monaco worker build from esbuild.config.ts. Remove Vue plugin if adapters are removed. Optionally remove scripts/generate-html.ts.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the build process completes successfully and that /sheets functions without errors.

tasks.title: Implement Worker-Based Formula Execution
tasks.description: Set up worker-based formula execution using RPC.
tasks.details: Configure examples/src/sheets/worker.ts to handle formula execution via RPC using @univerjs/rpc and @univerjs/engine-formula.
tasks.testStrategy: Test formula calculations in the Sheets UI to ensure they execute correctly and efficiently.

subtasks.title: Set Up RPC Communication
subtasks.details:
Configure the RPC setup in examples/src/sheets/worker.ts to enable communication between the worker and the main thread.
<info added on 2025-09-20T16:24:58.456Z>
RPC communication between the main and worker threads has been successfully established. The main thread in `examples/src/sheets/main.ts` creates the worker and registers the RPC main thread plugin, while the worker thread in `examples/src/sheets/worker.ts` registers the RPC worker plugin.
</info added on 2025-09-20T16:24:58.456Z>

subtasks.title: Configure Worker for Formula Execution
subtasks.description: Set up the worker to handle formula execution tasks.
subtasks.details:
Modify examples/src/sheets/worker.ts to process formula execution requests using @univerjs/engine-formula.
<info added on 2025-09-20T16:25:01.839Z>
Worker configured for formula execution.  
- File: `examples/src/sheets/worker.ts`  
  - Registers core engine and remote formula plugins:  
    - [UniverFormulaEnginePlugin]  
    - [UniverRemoteSheetsFormulaPlugin]  
  - Also includes [UniverSheetsPlugin, { onlyRegisterFormulaRelatedMutations: true }] and [UniverSheetsFilterPlugin]  
- Locales and logging set; worker exposes `self.univer`.  
Conclusion: Worker is properly configured to handle formula execution via RPC.
</info added on 2025-09-20T16:25:01.839Z>

subtasks.title: Implement Formula Execution Logic
subtasks.description: Implement the logic for executing formulas within the worker.
subtasks.details:
Develop the logic in the worker to execute formulas and return results using the configured RPC setup.
<info added on 2025-09-20T16:25:05.162Z>
Formula execution wiring confirmed. Main file `examples/src/sheets/main.ts` uses `[UniverFormulaEnginePlugin, { notExecuteFormula: true }]` and `[UniverSheetsFormulaPlugin, { notExecuteFormula: true }]`, delegating execution to remote. Worker file `examples/src/sheets/worker.ts` includes `[UniverFormulaEnginePlugin]` and `[UniverRemoteSheetsFormulaPlugin]`, routing formula execution to the worker. Conclusion: No additional execution code needed; remote execution flow is complete.
</info added on 2025-09-20T16:25:05.162Z>

subtasks.title: Test Worker-Based Formula Execution
subtasks.description: Test the functionality of formula execution via the worker.
subtasks.details: Conduct tests to ensure formulas are executed correctly and efficiently in the Sheets UI, verifying the integration of RPC and worker setup.

tasks.title: Enable CSV/XLSX Import/Export
tasks.description: Add optional support for CSV/XLSX import and export functionality.
tasks.details: Integrate xlsx and papaparse libraries to handle CSV/XLSX import/export in the Sheets UI.
tasks.testStrategy: Test importing and exporting CSV/XLSX files to ensure data integrity and correct functionality.

tasks.title: Verify and Document Changes
tasks.description: Document all changes made during the implementation process.
tasks.details: Create documentation outlining the changes made to achieve a Sheets-only build, including removed features and plugins.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for completeness and accuracy. Ensure it reflects the current state of the project.

tasks.title: Set Up Continuous Integration
tasks.description: Implement CI to ensure only the /sheets build is maintained.
tasks.details: Configure a CI pipeline to automatically build and test the /sheets project, ensuring no other demos are included.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the CI pipeline triggers on code changes and successfully builds and tests the /sheets project.
